name: nepal-pay
description: Unified, type-safe Nepal payment gateway SDK for eSewa (ePaisa V2), Khalti (V2), Fonepay (NepalQR), ConnectIPS (NCHL), and IME Pay. Zero dependencies. Next.js App Router & Express ready.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.mjs --target node --format esm && bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build ./src/next.ts --outfile ./dist/next.mjs --target node --format esm && bun build ./src/next.ts --outfile ./dist/next.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build ./src/express.ts --outfile ./dist/express.mjs --target node --format esm && bun build ./src/express.ts --outfile ./dist/express.cjs --target node --format cjs && npx -p typescript tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run test && bun run build

author: Ranjeet (https://github.com/Ranjeet2063)
